notes:
Account intro: CopperGlade builds an outbound-focused sales assistant for mid-market SaaS sellers. Primary product: in-app chat agents that can call CRM/email/calendar actions (HubSpot/Gmail/Google Calendar).

Conversation highlights:
- Interested in starting with Redwood Hosted API for quick time-to-value, then evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency/cost (6-9 month timeline).
- Primary ask: low-latency streaming for live agent-style interactions (pop-in suggestions, real-time compose), plus reliable tool calling (create/update contact, schedule meeting).
- Quoted on call: 'We need responses in <200ms token time for streaming UI to feel natural' — latency SLO is gating.
- Security: SSO (SAML) for internal admin, audit logs for tool calls, and KMS integration for customer keys; potential data residency requirement for EU customers.
- Cost sensitivity: unit cost matters; will accept Dedicated if ROI vs Hosted is clear for 10M+ tokens / month.

Current posture: product-led PM + infra eng champion. Looking for Redwood to demo streaming + function/tool-calling flow with HubSpot action prototype. POC should include failure/fallback behavior when Dedicated capacity is constrained (fallback to hosted-compatible variant).

Quoted POC deliverables (AE notes):
- Live demo: streaming chat UI + tool call (create HubSpot contact + schedule meeting) — Eleni to partner with SE for demo.
- 2-week hosted API sandbox with realistic throughput (simulate 200 concurrent sales reps, burst to 1k).
- Latency profiling report (p99 streaming & end-to-end tool call times).
- Pricing band estimate for Dedicated 3-month trial + monthly reserved capacity.

Risk flags/concerns:
- Legal wants explicit data residency clause for EU accounts; may force Private if unresolved.
- Finance expects line-item comparison (Hosted per-token vs Dedicated amortized cost).
- Engineering will need peering details for VPC and egress patterns.

Tactics / next actions (shorthand):
- Send hosted sandbox invite + sample load script (Jordan)
- SE to build HubSpot action demo + run internal dry-run (Eleni)
- Schedule AE+Finance pricing sync (Jordan + CopperGlade finance) week of 2026-03-15
- Start security questionnaire (security doc link in Drive)
